evidence.summary: Rewind onset: qdc tiles the ayah gaplessly, so where the reciter stops and goes back it stamps the next word's index on the instant of the rewind — a first-pass label shorter than any spoken word (< 200 ms), followed at once by the rewind, of a word the row recites later. clean_qdc_artifacts folds that instant into the word being finished. The stored occurrence sequence changes, so Arabic XLSR and MMS/uroman forced alignment both score the candidate sequence better than the baseline one on the exact EveryAyah file. Sudais ships on the re-clocked source row (v64-pipeline-resync.json); both models also place its word starts closer (XLSR 146 -> 97 ms, MMS 144 -> 94 ms mean residual).
